ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will require the field called Lease Status Reason to be populated if the Status Lease field contains a value of Not Interested, Not Qualified or Marketing Scrub.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED( Status_Lease__c) && ISPICKVAL(Lease_Status_Reason__c, "") && (ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested") || ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified") || ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Marketing Scrub"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a value from the Lease Status Reason field. Thank you.
